news.detail: Listed doubtful (thumb/ankle) for Sunday vs MIA after DNP all week; beat writers expect him to sit and return Thanksgiving.
Questionable (shoulder); limited Thursday. If he plays, Bills have more reason to rest Kincaid, boosting Hawes' TE role.
Questionable with hamstring; limited in practice Wednesday-Thursday.
Full participant (knee), no designation; cited as pass-game fill-in with Kincaid likely out.
Full participant (knee) in Thursday practice; no game designation.
Full practice Friday, off final injury report, no designation (knee). Was inactive Week 10.
Cleared final injury report (shoulder), no designation; full practice Friday.
Starting QB with Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve.
Listed on injured reserve with a thumb injury, estimated return late December; out vs Carolina.
In line to start with Lamar Jackson on IR (thumb); not on Ravens practice report.
Questionable with knee injury; did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
Questionable with knee injury; did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
Wednesday DNP was non-injury rest; no injury designation reported.
Full participant Wednesday with a wrist issue; no designation reported.
Full participant Wednesday and Thursday with a hand injury; no designation.
Practiced fully Thursday/Friday after Wednesday non-participation for personal reasons; no designation reported.
Shoulder; fully participated in practice all week, no designation.
Chest; upgraded to full practice Friday and will play after 11 catches last week.
Says hamstring is healthy but will require treatment all season; no injury designation this week.
Biceps; ruled out along with RTs Taliese Fuaga and Asim Richards — three OL starters missing.
Ruled out Friday with an ankle injury for Sunday vs. Titans (model had him questionable).
Did not practice Friday (illness); officially questionable. With Ferguson out, his status drives the TE snaps.
Jake Ferguson ruled out (knee/ankle) and Schoonmaker questionable, leaving Bellinger in line for expanded TE role.
Full participant Friday (shoulder) after two limited days; still listed questionable — trending to play.
Knee; DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday, full Friday. Questionable but trending up.
Veteran rest DNP Thursday, full Friday, no game designation — expected to handle lead-back work.
Official Questionable (foot/right thumb); DNP Wed, limited Thu/Fri; said 'I feel ready'. Final call expected game day.
Took first-team reps all week; starts if Mayfield inactive. Earlier in week reported as trending toward the start.
Thursday DNP was a rest day; full participant Friday and carries no game designation.
Thursday DNP was rest; full participant Friday, no designation on final injury report.
Full participant Wednesday with thumb injury; no game designation.
Questionable (ankle); limited Wed/Thu/Fri, hasn't missed game time, expected to play.
Chiefs not expecting Walker (groin) to play vs. Cardinals; he already missed Week 11.
Rookie filled in well for Walker in Week 11 and is set to lead the backfield again with Walker expected out.
Added to injury report Thursday as limited with a back injury; back spasms flared up this week.
Cardinals preparing to start veteran Josh Johnson at QB with Beck's back spasms flaring.
On injured reserve with a foot injury; earliest return projected Week 15.
Placed on injured reserve with an elbow injury, forcing the rookie/veteran QB shuffle.
On injured reserve with a neck injury; out for this game.
On PUP with an ankle injury, expected back around Week 12; status for Sunday unconfirmed.
Left off Friday's final injury report with no game status after Thursday DNP (ankle/foot); expected to play, remains lead back.
Was limited Wednesday, downgraded to non-participant Thursday with ankle/foot; ankle has bothered him three weeks.
Hamstring; full participant in practice all week, Giants described as near full strength for Sunday.
Starting QB out with left arm injury suffered vs Washington; per Nov. 17 Big Ten availability report.
